g.text: 1951 Minsky & Edmonds — SNARC First NN Hardware

1979 AI Hype Collapses — Research Labs Defunded
1990 Werbos, Williams — RNNs Back-prop Through Time
1993 DARPA — Cuts AI Funding, Winter Deepens
2003 Google — PageRank ML at Production Scale

2005 Stanford Stanley — DARPA Grand Challenge Win
2006 Hinton — Deep Belief Networks Nature Paper
2007 NVIDIA — CUDA GPU Computing for Science
2008 Hinton & Google — DL Applied to Speech
2011 Apple — Siri First Mainstream AI Assistant
2015 He et al. — ResNet 152 Layers Surpasses Human
2017 Vaswani et al. — Attention Is All You Need
2022 Stability AI — Stable Diffusion Open Source
2023 Meta — LLaMA 2 Open for Commercial Use
2025 AI — Agentic Era Autonomous Multi-Step Agents
